optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fleet Analytics Analyst, Waste Collection Services
professionalSummary: Three‑year Fleet Analytics Analyst with proven expertise in analysing round telematics and tipping data, proposing and validating round changes, preparing monthly contract performance reports, and presenting findings to depot managers while documenting objections and resolutions.
experienceHighlights: Analyzed telematics and tipping data for eleven depots following the team’s analysis procedure; proposed 34 round changes with documented mileage and time effects, 29 of which met post‑change telematics targets; prepared monthly contract performance reports for contract managers; presented each change to depot managers, recorded objections and resolutions; authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for every proposal.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Two round change proposals with approval records and post‑change telematics; one monthly contract performance report; two depot review records, all linked to the analytics platform for verification.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples confirm the candidate’s experience and achievements in all core responsibilities of the Fleet Analytics Analyst role, but do not provide independent verification of the quality of the analyses or the impact on overall fleet performance.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to assess depth of analysis and stakeholder management.

role.roleTitle: Fleet Analytics Analyst, Waste Collection Services

evidence.text: Fleet analytics analyst at a waste collection company for three years, analysing the round telematics and tipping data for the company's eleven depots under the team's analysis procedure.

Work sample: two round change proposals with their approval records and post‑change telematics, one monthly contract performance report and two depot review records, with the analytics platform references as a verification trail.

Proposed thirty‑four round changes with their expected mileage and time effects; the approvals were the operations director's, recorded on each proposal, and the post‑change telematics confirmed the expected effect within the tolerance on twenty‑nine of them.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of proposal and approval.

evidence.text: In the depot manager role‑play, when the panel member objected that the proposed round ignored a school‑run road closure, the candidate pulled up the closure window on the map, moved the affected stops to after the window, restated the revised time saving, and noted the objection and the revision on the proposal sheet.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates handling objections and revising proposals.

evidence.text: Prepared the monthly contract performance report for the contract managers under the report template, filed in the contracts folder.
Work sample: one monthly contract performance report.
Presented each round change to the depot manager concerned in the depot review, with the depot review record listing the manager's objections and how each was resolved or carried to the director.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of presentation and objection recording.

evidence.text: Candidate pulled up the closure window on the map, moved the affected stops to after the window, restated the revised time saving, and noted the objection and the revision on the proposal sheet.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand‑over conditions of each round change proposal for the depot.
Work sample: two round change proposals with their approval records and post‑change telematics.
evidence.notes: Sample includes limitation and hand‑over sections.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate has performed all core responsibilities of a Fleet Analytics Analyst in a waste collection context.
supportedClaims.witness: Fleet analytics analyst at a waste collection company for three years, analysing the round telematics and tipping data for the company's eleven depots under the team's analysis procedure.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you describe the specific analysis procedure your team follows when evaluating round telematics and tipping data?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Detailed description of analysis steps and tools used.

followUpQuestions.question: How do you typically handle depot manager objections that cannot be resolved within the proposed round changes?

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the candidate’s analysis procedure aligns with the company’s current methodology.
Confirm that the candidate’s documented limitations and hand‑over conditions meet regulatory and operational standards.
Assess the depth of stakeholder engagement demonstrated in the interview notes.
